feature_contract.goal: Preserve first-draw stereo eligibility for explicitly transformed XYZRHW D3D9 vertex buffers created and filled before the lazy CPU shadow arm; keep other vertex/index streams untouched and retain conservative fallbacks.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only packaged R26+HUD comparison-owner XYZ/RHW FVF vertex-buffer creation and write tracking; no broad world VB capture, texture changes, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK or unrelated HUD/rank/GOAL semantic rerouting.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Exact Quest3 source SHA 1d161a18efcf had sampled frame spikes up to 309.306 ms and 2,050 below-60 samples (Issue #119); these are general measured frame stability symptoms, not proof this issue caused the spikes. Code proves first Draw arms the shadow after initial writes, so early XYZRHW VB writes are inaccessible for stereo; this change targets that deterministic admission gap without claiming measured FPS gains.
trace_stages: Game CreateVertexBuffer explicitly advertises D3DFVF_XYZRHW before original Lock/Unlock producer writes.
R30 captured Lock/Unlock bytes reach the same existing CPU shadow that DrawPrimitive's R30CopyVertexShadow consumes without a synchronous GPU Lock.
Per-eye R30ExecuteXyzrhwStereo uses the unchanged left/right transform and falls back to R29 when data or proof is missing.
subcomponents: Pre-register only game-owned FVF-proven transformed buffers during D3D9 creation; leave declaration-based and ordinary world buffers on lazy admission.
Include exact pre-registered vertex buffers in write Lock/Unlock shadow snapshots ahead of the global draw arm, respecting overlay, failed locks, device reset and original Draw fallback.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: D3D9 buffer creation through first Draw
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Explicit XYZRHW FVF creation registers CPU shadow before the first game write Lock, so the first eligible Draw can use observed vertex bytes without synchronous GPU readback.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Ordinary world and external overlay buffer safety
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Ordinary XYZ, FVF=0 declaration buffers, failed locks and external overlay writes are not prematurely copied; unobserved ranges continue to delegate to conservative R29.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Packaged owner and exact SHA CI
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portable positive/negative smoke plus exact-SHA Windows DX9Ex game/host/package and Domain/affected source checks pass without CI skip.

diagnosis.original_evidence: In the R26+HUD packaged renderer, R30BufferShadowCaptureArmed is initially false and changes to true only inside R30TryXyzrhwPrimitiveVB/IndexedPrimitiveVB at the first draw, after ordinary CreateVertexBuffer and Lock/Unlock may have already occurred.
diagnosis.root_cause: A known XYZRHW FVF vertex buffer written before its first Draw is not registered for CPU shadow at Create, so R30CopyVertexShadow lacks bytes and fails open to mono/delegated drawing on initial use.
alternatives_rejected: Do not turn on global shadow capture during every world buffer creation: it defeats the intentional lazy world geometry fast path.
Do not use a draw-time GPU buffer READONLY Lock: it can block/stall or fail for WRITEONLY resources.
Do not infer POSITIONT from a declaration-only FVF=0 CreateVertexBuffer: proof is missing.
diagnosis.measured_evidence: Issue #119 reports user-observed flicker/stability issues and game frame sampling, but exact GPU-frame causation awaits matching HMD profiling.

runtime_evidence: No live game/Quest3/VDXR test in this job; first-frame optical correction and hardware FPS impact not verified.
